name: plugin.garf_reporting_pipeline
description: Google Garf declarative SQL reporting, synthetic simulation, multi-destination data pipeline, and workflow DAG execution bridge

entrypoints.name: garf_parse_query
entrypoints.description: Parse a reporting API SQL query into structured components (fields, aliases, filters, sorts, limit, dynamic macros)

parameters.name: query_text
parameters.description: SQL query text (e.g. SELECT id, metrics.clicks AS clicks FROM campaigns WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 10)

parameters.name: macros
parameters.description: Optional dictionary of custom macro key-value replacements

entrypoints.name: garf_simulate_report
entrypoints.description: Deterministically simulate a tabular report matching SQL query specifications without live network API calls

parameters.name: query_text
parameters.description: SQL query text specifying columns and resource name

parameters.name: row_count
parameters.description: Number of synthetic rows to generate (default: 5)

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Deterministic PRNG seed for reproducible test results (default: 42)

entrypoints.name: garf_write_report
entrypoints.description: Write a tabular report batch to target storage (CSV, JSON, SQLite, Console)

parameters.name: report_data
parameters.description: Serialized GarfReportBatch dictionary containing column_names, rows, and row_count

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: Filesystem path for target output file

entrypoints.name: garf_execute_query
entrypoints.description: End-to-end execution: parses query, simulates/fetches report, and optionally writes to target destination

parameters.name: query_text
parameters.description: SQL query string for reporting API

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: Optional filesystem path for written output

entrypoints.name: garf_run_workflow
entrypoints.description: Execute a multi-step analytical workflow DAG orchestrating API data queries and SQL post-processing

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: List of workflow step specifications with step_id, step_type, sql_query, writer_type, destination, and depends_on

parameters.name: context_params
parameters.description: Optional initial dictionary of execution context variables
